project.name: dagangan
project.description: Vue 3 + TypeScript dashboard for partner and product management with Supabase integration

nodes.name: main.ts
nodes.summary: Application entry point that initializes Vue app with Pinia and Router, sets up authentication state from Supabase session

nodes.name: App.vue
nodes.summary: Root Vue component that renders router-view and conditionally displays MobileNavbar based on route, initializes theme

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Vue Router configuration with authentication guard, defines routes for dashboard, products, partners, shipments, returns, payments

nodes.name: supabase.ts
nodes.summary: Supabase client initialization with environment variables for URL and anonymous key

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Pinia auth store managing user session state and auth state cleanup

nodes.name: counter.ts
nodes.summary: Pinia counter store example with increment action and doubleCount computed property

nodes.name: theme.ts
nodes.summary: Pinia theme store for dark/light mode management with localStorage persistence and HTML attribute manipulation

nodes.name: DefaultLayout.vue
nodes.summary: Main application layout with sticky header, sidebar navigation, and footer for authenticated pages, includes Metronic component initialization

nodes.name: AuthLayout.vue
nodes.summary: Authentication layout with centered form container and background image for login/signup pages

nodes.name: Header.vue
nodes.summary: Top header component with sticky positioning and Metronic-based menu system with drawer toggles

nodes.name: Sidebar.vue
nodes.summary: Navigation sidebar component fetching dashboard statistics from service, displaying user menu with logout functionality

nodes.name: Footer.vue
nodes.summary: Footer component with empty template

nodes.name: MobileNavbar.vue
nodes.summary: Mobile navigation bar component with router links for dashboard, shipments, returns, and payments

nodes.name: DesktopDashboard.vue
nodes.summary: Desktop dashboard view displaying KPI cards with CSS grid layout, charts for revenue trends, top products, returns, and product quantities

nodes.name: MobileDashboard.vue
nodes.summary: Mobile dashboard view with tab switching between all data and filtered monthly data, displaying KPI cards and mobile-optimized charts

nodes.name: AuthService.ts
nodes.summary: Authentication service providing login, logout, and getCurrentUser methods using Supabase authentication

nodes.name: DashboardService.ts
nodes.summary: Dashboard data service fetching shipment data from Supabase with joins, calculating statistics, trends, top products, and return metrics

nodes.name: MobileDashboardService.ts
nodes.summary: Mobile dashboard service fetching filtered shipment data with optional month/year filtering, calculating omzet, pendapatan, piutang, and product metrics

nodes.name: ProductService.ts
nodes.summary: Product CRUD service providing getAll, create, update, and delete operations for products in Supabase

nodes.name: PartnerService.ts
nodes.summary: Partner CRUD service providing getAll, create, update, and delete operations for partners in Supabase

nodes.name: PaymentService.ts
nodes.summary: Supabase service for payment and shipment management. Exports paymentService object with getAllShipments() method that fetches and enriches shipment data with partner, payment, and return information.

nodes.name: ReturnService.ts
nodes.summary: Supabase service for return management. Exports returnService with getAllCombined() method that aggregates shipment, return, and payment data for three return statuses (queue, active, closed).

nodes.name: ShipmentService.ts
nodes.summary: Supabase service for shipment operations. Exports shipmentService with getAll() method that fetches shipments with related partners, payments, returns, and details, computing enriched fields like payment status and return metrics.

nodes.name: Dashboard.vue
nodes.summary: Main dashboard view with responsive layout. Conditionally renders DesktopDashboard or MobileDashboard based on media query (max-width: 991px). Uses ref and lifecycle hooks for media query listener.

nodes.name: Login.vue
nodes.summary: Authentication login view. Manages email/password input with validation, loading state, and password visibility toggle. Integrates authService for login and routes to dashboard on success or shows error alerts.

nodes.name: HomeView.vue
nodes.summary: Home/dashboard view displaying KPI cards for unpaid invoices and product inventory metrics with Metronic styling.

nodes.name: LainnyaView.vue
nodes.summary: Master data navigation view providing router links to product, partner, and other master data management sections.

nodes.name: Shipments.vue
nodes.summary: Empty shipments view component (minimal template).

nodes.name: PartnerList.vue
nodes.summary: Partner/store management view. Displays searchable grid of partners with details (name, address, markup fixed). Supports add, edit, and delete operations via modals. Uses formatNumber utility for currency display.

nodes.name: PaymentList.vue
nodes.summary: Payment management view with tabbed interface for unpaid and paid shipments. Displays shipment cards with payment status, partner info, totals, and return deductions. Tab-based filtering with badge counters.

nodes.name: ProductList.vue
nodes.summary: Product catalog management view. Displays searchable grid of products with name, base price, and unit. Supports add, edit, and delete operations through modal forms. Includes loading states and empty states.

nodes.name: ReturnForm.vue
nodes.summary: Return form for inputting return items (barang sisa). Allows selection of shipment and return date, then displays itemized return quantities with shipping quantities for comparison. Form-based interface for return data entry.

nodes.name: ReturnList.vue
nodes.summary: Return management list view with three-tab interface: queue (belum input), active (diisi), and closed (selesai). Displays shipment cards with partner info, payment status, and return item counts. Supports filtering and row click navigation.

nodes.name: ShipmentForm.vue
nodes.summary: Shipment creation/edit form with two-column layout. Left panel: shipment details (partner selection, date, expected payment). Right panel: product catalog search and selection. Supports partner modal selection and shipment date/tempo date inputs.

nodes.name: ShipmentList.vue
nodes.summary: Shipment list view with tabbed interface for active and completed shipments. Displays shipment cards with partner info, invoice status (paid/unpaid), return status (SISA count), and financial metrics. Quick modal support.

nodes.name: AllProductQtyChart.vue
nodes.summary: ApexCharts bar chart component showing total sold quantity per product. Accepts data prop with product names and quantities. Renders horizontal bar chart with purple color scheme.

nodes.name: ProductReturnBarChart.vue
nodes.summary: Chart component for product return analysis. Minimal implementation with chart placeholder element.

nodes.name: RevenueAreaChart.vue
nodes.summary: ApexCharts area chart component displaying revenue trends. Accepts data array with x (timestamp) and y (revenue) values. Renders smooth area chart with green color and data validation.

nodes.name: TopProductChart.vue
nodes.summary: ApexCharts horizontal bar chart displaying top 5 best-selling products by total paid sales. Accepts data with product names and totals. Includes currency formatting for x-axis labels.

nodes.name: TopReturnProductChart.vue
nodes.summary: ApexCharts horizontal bar chart showing products with highest return quantities. Accepts data with product names and return quantities. Uses red color scheme for return metrics.

nodes.name: MobileAllProductQtyChart.vue
nodes.summary: Mobile-optimized Vue 3 component rendering a bar chart displaying total product quantities sold. Uses ApexCharts library to visualize quantity data with responsive styling and empty state handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Vue 3 SFC with <script setup> and TypeScript. Declares ApexCharts as external global. Uses onMounted and watch hooks for chart lifecycle and data reactivity.

nodes.name: MobileKpiCard.vue
nodes.summary: Reusable mobile KPI (Key Performance Indicator) card component displaying a metric label, formatted currency value, icon, and optional subtitle. Supports variant styling through computed classes.
nodes.languageNotes: Vue 3 SFC with <script setup>. Uses computed properties for derived styling and formatted values. Accepts props: label, value, iconClass, subtitle, variant.

nodes.name: MobileRevenueAreaChart.vue
nodes.summary: Mobile-optimized Vue 3 component rendering an area chart displaying daily revenue trends. Transforms date/value pairs into formatted categories and handles empty states gracefully.
nodes.languageNotes: Vue 3 SFC using ApexCharts. Processes date data (x, y) props into formatted chart categories. Includes data validation and safe number coercion.

nodes.name: MobileTopProductChart.vue
nodes.summary: Mobile chart component displaying top 5 best-selling products as a horizontal bar chart with Indonesian rupiah (Rp) formatting. Includes empty state UI with icon and message.
nodes.languageNotes: Vue 3 SFC with ApexCharts. Formats currency values using Intl.NumberFormat for Indonesian locale. Charts are destroyable and re-rendered on prop changes.

nodes.name: MobileTopReturnProductChart.vue
nodes.summary: Mobile component rendering a horizontal bar chart showing products with the highest return quantities. Displays product names and return count with responsive styling and empty state.
nodes.languageNotes: Vue 3 SFC with ApexCharts. Similar structure to MobileTopProductChart but for return metrics instead of sales. Uses red color scheme (#F1416C) for returns.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Project manifest defining the 'dagangan' Vue 3 + TypeScript dashboard application with dependencies: Vue 3.5.29, Vue Router 5.0.3, Pinia 3.0.4, Supabase 2.99.1. Build toolchain includes Vite 7.3.1 and PWA support.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON. Specifies ES modules (type: module). Build scripts use 'run-p' for parallel execution. Node requirement: 20.19.0+ or 22.12.0+.

nodes.name: package-lock.json
nodes.summary: Npm lockfile containing resolved dependency tree and integrity hashes for reproducible builds. Locks 7680 lines of transitive dependencies for Vue, Vite, TypeScript, and Supabase ecosystem.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON lockfile format. Generated by npm. Essential for CI/CD reproducibility.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration for Vue 3 SPA with PWA support. Configures Vue plugin, path aliases (@/* → ./src/*), PWA manifest with icons, and workbox caching (5MB limit) for offline support.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Imports Vite defineConfig, Vue plugin, VitePWA. Defines PWA manifest metadata including app name 'Tracking Dagangan', icons, and workbox globals patterns.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript configuration file serving as a monorepo-style composite config that references tsconfig.node.json and tsconfig.app.json for separate compilation contexts.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON. Uses TypeScript project references feature to separate Node build tools from app code compilation.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: Application-specific TypeScript configuration extending @vue/tsconfig DOM presets. Enables strict array/object indexing, path mapping for @ alias, and builds incremental .tsbuildinfo files in node_modules/.tmp/.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON extending @vue/tsconfig/tsconfig.dom.json. Includes src/**/*.vue files, excludes src/**/__tests__/* directories.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for Node.js build tools (Vite, Vitest, Playwright, ESLint). Uses bundler module resolution and preserves module syntax for ESM compatibility.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON extending @tsconfig/node24. Sets moduleResolution to 'bundler' for better tool support. No emit during type-checking.

nodes.name: env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Vite client type definitions and environment variable interfaces. Declares VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY as readonly string environment variables for type-safe import.meta.env access.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript ambient module declarations (no export). Triple-slash reference to vite/client types. Interface ImportMetaEnv extends import.meta.env typing.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Single-page application HTML entry point. Loads Metronic CSS and JavaScript bundles, imports Vue app from src/main.ts, and configures PWA/manifest metadata.
nodes.languageNotes: HTML5. Includes X-Frame-Options clickjacking protection. Loads external fonts from Google Fonts and global plugin/theme bundles.

nodes.name: .gitignore
nodes.summary: Git ignore patterns excluding node_modules, build artifacts (dist/), environment secrets (.env files), editor configs, logs, and PWA/service worker artifacts.
nodes.languageNotes: Plaintext glob patterns. Explicitly guards .env, .env.local, and .env.*.js to prevent secret leakage. Excludes PWA artifacts and test captures.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project README documenting Vue 3 + Vite setup, IDE recommendations (VS Code + Volar), browser devtools setup for Vue debugging, TypeScript support via vue-tsc, and build/dev commands.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown. Includes sections on IDE setup, type support, and build commands. Provides links to Vue devtools extensions and configuration references.

nodes.name: database-context.md
nodes.summary: Database schema documentation for Supabase backend. Defines 7 core tables: partners (sellers), products, shipments, shipment_details, payments, returns, return_details. Includes column types and constraints.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown tables documenting UUID PKs, foreign keys to user_id, and nullable timestamp/numeric fields for commerce domain.

nodes.name: .env
nodes.summary: Environment configuration file storing Supabase connection credentials: VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY for API authentication.
nodes.languageNotes: Shell-style KEY=VALUE format. Contains sensitive credentials (anon key) that should not be committed. CRITICAL: This file is listed in .gitignore.

nodes.name: deploy.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow automating build and deployment to staging server. Triggers on main branch push. Steps: checkout → setup Node 22 → install cloudflared → npm build → rsync deploy via SSH tunnel.
nodes.languageNotes: YAML workflow. Uses cloudflared for SSH tunneling through Cloudflare. Builds with environment secrets (VITE_SUPABASE_*) before deployment.

nodes.name: payments
nodes.summary: Supabase payments table recording payment transactions. Fields: id (uuid PK), shipment_id (FK), amount_received (numeric), payment_date, created_at.
nodes.languageNotes: PostgreSQL table. Foreign key to shipments. Used by PaymentService for revenue tracking.

nodes.name: products
nodes.summary: Supabase products table storing seller inventory. Fields: id (uuid PK), user_id (FK to users), name (text), base_price (numeric), unit (text nullable), created_at.
nodes.languageNotes: PostgreSQL table. user_id scopes products to sellers. Used by ProductService and ProductList view.

nodes.name: shipments
nodes.summary: Supabase shipments table tracking orders to partners. Fields: id (uuid PK), user_id, partner_id (FK), shipment_date, expected_payment_date, total_amount, status, notes, created_at.
nodes.languageNotes: PostgreSQL table. Core transaction record linking users, partners, and payments. Used by ShipmentService and dashboard analytics.

nodes.name: returns
nodes.summary: Supabase returns table recording product returns/refunds. Fields: id (uuid PK), user_id, shipment_id (FK), return_date (date), notes (text nullable), created_at.
nodes.languageNotes: PostgreSQL table. Links to shipments for RMA tracking. Used by ReturnService and return analytics.

nodes.name: return_details
nodes.summary: Supabase return_details line-item table. Fields: id (uuid PK), return_id (FK), product_id (FK), quantity_returned (int4).
nodes.languageNotes: PostgreSQL table. Denormalizes return quantities per product for detailed RMA analysis.

nodes.name: payments_rows.sql
nodes.summary: Sample data INSERT statements for payments table. 16 payment records with amounts ranging 150k-647.5k IDR, dated April-May 2026, demonstrating payment workflow.
nodes.languageNotes: SQL INSERT statements. Values include UUID shipment FKs, numeric amounts, and timestamptz records.

nodes.name: products_rows.sql
nodes.summary: Sample product inventory INSERT statements. Multiple product records with base prices in IDR, units (pcs, box), and creation timestamps for dashboard testing.
nodes.languageNotes: SQL INSERT statements. Demonstrates various unit types and price ranges for commerce calculations.

nodes.name: returns_rows.sql
nodes.summary: Sample return records INSERT statements demonstrating return transactions linked to shipments, with return dates and optional notes for quality tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: SQL INSERT statements. Records link user_id → return_id → shipment_id for quality/RMA workflows.

nodes.name: return_details_rows.sql
nodes.summary: Sample return detail line items INSERT statements linking specific products to returns with returned quantity counts for granular RMA tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: SQL INSERT statements. Denormalizes return quantities per product for detailed analytics.

nodes.name: shipments_rows.sql
nodes.summary: Sample shipment records INSERT statements with shipment dates, partner assignments, total amounts (500k-1M IDR range), and status/notes for order tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: SQL INSERT statements. Core transaction records seeding dashboard analytics and payment workflows.

edges.notes: HTML entry point imports Vue app from src/main.ts
Provides type definitions for Vite environment variables used in app config

CI/CD builds and packages dependencies from package.json
Deployment pipeline injects secrets from .env into build process
Shipments have FK to payments (payment_date, total_amount)
Returns reference shipments via shipment_id FK
Return details line items reference returns via return_id FK
Return details reference products via product_id FK

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand the project's purpose, development setup, and available npm scripts.
tour.languageLesson: Vue 3 with Vite and TypeScript: A modern, fast development environment

tour.title: Application Bootstrap
tour.description: Explore main.ts, the entry point that initializes Vue app, Pinia store for auth state, and performs auth verification on startup.
tour.languageLesson: TypeScript modules: Entry point pattern with store initialization and side effects

tour.title: Root Component & Router Setup
tour.description: App.vue is the root component that renders the router outlet. Router configuration in src/router/index.ts defines routes and protects them with auth guards.
tour.languageLesson: Vue Router: Authentication guards, route definitions, and lazy-loaded page components

tour.title: Layout Structure
tour.description: DefaultLayout.vue provides the authenticated UI structure with Header, Sidebar, and Footer. This wraps most application pages and ensures consistent navigation.
tour.languageLesson: Vue composition: Layout wrapper pattern for consistent UX across multiple pages

tour.title: Authentication & Login
tour.description: Login.vue is the entry page for unauthenticated users. AuthService.ts handles Supabase authentication, and the auth store manages session state.
tour.languageLesson: Service pattern: Separation of concerns between UI (Login.vue) and business logic (AuthService)

tour.title: Dashboard & Analytics
tour.description: Dashboard.vue displays analytics with KPI cards and charts. DashboardService fetches aggregated data from Supabase for overview metrics.
tour.languageLesson: Vue 3 components with TypeScript: Reactive data binding and lifecycle hooks for dashboard data

tour.title: Product Management Module
tour.description: ProductList.vue displays products in a table with CRUD operations. ProductService.ts provides API calls to Supabase for product data management.
tour.languageLesson: CRUD pattern: List view with service layer abstraction for database operations

tour.title: Partner Management Module
tour.description: PartnerList.vue manages partners/sellers. PartnerService.ts handles Supabase queries for partner data and relationships.
tour.languageLesson: Modular architecture: Feature-based folder structure (partners/, products/, etc.)

tour.title: Shipment Tracking Module
tour.description: ShipmentList.vue shows active shipments. ShipmentService.ts manages shipment lifecycle and status updates via Supabase.
tour.languageLesson: Real-time data: Service pattern for tracking order fulfillment and logistics

tour.title: Payment Processing Module
tour.description: PaymentList.vue displays payment history and status. PaymentService.ts manages payment records and transaction data in Supabase.
tour.languageLesson: Financial data handling: Service abstraction for sensitive transaction information

tour.title: Return Requests Module
tour.description: ReturnList.vue and ReturnForm.vue handle return requests. ReturnService.ts manages return lifecycle from creation to resolution.
tour.languageLesson: Form handling & state management: Multi-step workflows with service layer coordination

tour.title: Supabase Integration
tour.description: supabase.ts initializes the Supabase client with environment configuration. All services import and use this client to query the backend database.
tour.languageLesson: Backend integration: Client initialization pattern and singleton pattern for shared connections

tour.title: Database Schema
tour.description: database-context.md documents the Supabase schema including tables for products, partners, shipments, payments, and returns.
tour.languageLesson: Database design: Relational structure supporting multi-entity business domain

tour.title: Project Configuration
tour.description: package.json defines dependencies (Vue 3, TypeScript, Supabase client, Pinia) and build scripts. Review to understand tech stack and tooling.
tour.languageLesson: Project metadata: Dependencies, scripts, and version management in modern JavaScript projects
